gaps.sentence: The government made a formal ___ (DECLARE) of intent to invest in rail.
gaps.explanation: 'A formal declaration' — the noun follows the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The programme aims at the ___ (EDUCATE) of young farmers.
The ___ (SAFE) of passengers is our priority.
gaps.explanation: 'Safety' — the quality noun from safe (safe → safety).

gaps.sentence: The document is of great ___ (IMPORTANT) to the case.
Their ___ (FRIEND) goes back to their university days.
gaps.explanation: 'Friendship' is the relationship between friends; 'friendliness' is a manner.

gaps.sentence: A side-by-side ___ (COMPARE) of the two plans reveals clear differences.
gaps.explanation: 'A comparison of X and Y' — the noun form follows the article and adjective.

gaps.sentence: The project's ___ (FAIL) was due to poor planning.
Her ___ (APPOINT) as captain surprised no one.
gaps.explanation: 'Her appointment as captain' — the event of being appointed.
